run_MDRunner_calculate: run a molecular dynamics simulation on a single structure using an ASE calculator and thermostat
create_MDRunner_init: create an MDRunner instance with a calculator, thermostat, atoms object, timestep, and total steps
write_MDRunner_results: write simulation results metadata as JSON including trajectory file, log file, and elapsed time
save_MDRunner_simulation_state: save the MD simulation state including atoms positions, thermostat state, and step count to a checkpoint directory
load_MDRunner_simulation_state: load MD simulation state from a checkpoint directory to resume from a previous step
